articles.title: Coinbase downgraded at Morgan Stanley; price target slashed 53% on weak earnings outlook
articles.snippet: Analyst Michael Cyprys cited weak crypto trading activity and doubts about an earnings recovery.

articles.title: Tokenization firm tZERO plans to go public in $350 million SPAC deal
articles.snippet: The digital securities firm plans to list on NYSE American under TZRO early next year after more than a decade building blockchain-based trading infrastructure.

articles.title: FATF targets crypto hubs in review of money laundering controls
articles.snippet: The watchdog has not named the jurisdictions under review. Initial findings on compliance with its crypto standards are due in June 2027.

articles.title: Claude-Built Linux Exploit Targets Bug That Ubuntu Still Hasn't Patched
articles.snippet: Anthropic says Claude wrote an attack that can take over a Linux server with no password. Red Hat patched on Sunday, but Ubuntu still has no fix.

articles.title: Proton Users Revolt After CEO Calls Security Caution 'Loser Thinking' Amid AI Push
articles.snippet: Proton customers say they are canceling subscriptions after reports of pressure to adopt AI coding, as the privacy company scraps employee re-interviews but defends its broader shift toward automated development.
